fieldContext.note: ATDD & BDD eliminate ambiguity by expressing requirements in executable test language: Given <context>, When <stimulus>, Then <outcome>.

personalNotes: ATDD/BDD test cases are unambiguous statements of requirement: modifying 'we expect the software to produce Y' to 'the software shall produce Y' converts a test case directly into a formal requirement.
